sections.body: ROADS: Stop, look both ways, listen, then cross with a grown-up. Use crossings when you can.
WATER: Only swim with a grown-up watching. Never go near deep water alone.
EMERGENCIES: If someone is badly hurt or there's a fire, get a grown-up. Grown-ups call the emergency number.
Emergency numbers are different in each country, such as 112, 911, 999 or 000. Learn yours with a grown-up!
Teach your child your local emergency number and their own address. Practise crossing roads together.

quiz.q: Before crossing a road, you should…
options: Stop, look both ways and listen
hints: Cars can come from both sides.
At a crossing, people stop, look left and right, then cross. What's the first step?
quiz.explain: Stop, look both ways and listen, and cross with a grown-up.

quiz.q: Your friend wants to swim in a river with no grown-up around. What should you do?
options: Say no and tell a grown-up
hints: Is it safe without a grown-up watching?
Water can be deep and fast.
We only cross roads with a grown-up. Swimming is the same.
quiz.explain: Say no and get a grown-up. Never swim without a grown-up watching.
